_: The contract of the instance backend-conventions: what is measured, how, with which weights and thresholds.
Written and committed before the first coder run (arc 5, S2, 2026-09-23). Law: never moved after a result is seen.
Every <rule id> of the seed prompt has one row in rules; test_put_contract fails when a rule has no check.
applies: 'all' or a list of task tags; a rule that does not apply to a task leaves that task's denominators.
kind: deterministic (computed from the diff, the tool trace or the test reports) or judge (a criterion of rubric r4).

rules.predicate: at least one graph query before the first Edit or Write (1); a graph query only after it (0.5); none (0). Clarified 2026-09-23 before any baseline run: the rule says 'before you change code', so read-only Bash does not count as a change.
before the first Edit or Write, a Read of an existing src/main or db/changelog file, other than the files the task changes, whose base content matches one of the task's exemplar patterns
share of new src/main files placed under one of the task's feature package prefixes
no added @Autowired line in src/main; every new @Service, @Component, @RestController or @Configuration class has @RequiredArgsConstructor or declares a constructor
per added listener method: @TransactionalEventListener with phase AFTER_COMMIT (1) and no @EventListener; its body has a catch (0.5 each)

per added @Scheduled method: @SchedulerLock present; lock name matches area:jobName; cron from a ${...} property; an enabled flag from @Value("${...}") in the class; class name ends with CronJob (mean of 5)
a new interface *Port under the task's port_dir; a new class *Adapter under adapter_dir implementing it; no file outside adapter_dir imports an adapter class (mean of 3)

every exception the added src/main code creates (`new XException(` or `new XError(`, thrown directly or from a supplier) is a TranslatableException type (the class or a subclass, known at the base or added in the diff); every task i18n key and every error./validation. key literal in added code is present in both messages_en.properties and messages_pl.properties (mean of the two shares). Clarified 2026-09-23 before any baseline run: suppliers such as orElseThrow(() -> new X()) count.

a new changeset file whose path matches db/changelog/YYYY/MM/DD-MM-YYYY-kebab.sql; its first line is the formatted-sql header; it has a --changeset author:id line; it has a -- rollback line; changelog.xml adds its include preceded by a <!-- Month YYYY: comment; no existing changeset is modified; the changeset touches the task's table and column (mean of 7)

the contended entity gains @Version on a version field (1) and a changeset the diff adds or edits adds the version column (1) (mean of 2); editing an old changeset is liquibase_changeset's failure, not this rule's
per added @GetMapping/@PostMapping/@PutMapping/@PatchMapping/@DeleteMapping/@RequestMapping method in a controller: @PreAuthorize on the method, and @RateLimit on the method or the class
per added mapping method: every @RequestBody type ends with DtoIn; the returned body type (inside ResponseEntity<...>, List<...>, Page<...>) ends with DtoOut, or is Void
0 when no new *UnitTest.java under src/test; else the mean of: uses MockitoExtension and no @SpringBootTest/@DataJpaTest/@WebMvcTest; compiles; its tests pass
mvnw -q test-compile exits 0 on the agent's working tree
no test file deleted; no file outside src/main, src/test and the two message bundles changed; at most 12 files changed
the completion line is present in the final answer and no tool call follows it
passed / total over the task's hidden acceptance tests (FAIL_TO_PASS) and its pass_to_pass classes, from the surefire reports; 0 when the build fails

gates.build_green: a run whose build is red scores hidden_pass 0 and tests_written 0; the gate rows are reported, not weighted

statistics.rule_pass_note: a rule passes a run when its value is 1.0 (partial credit counts in the score, never in a compliance rate)
statistics.delta: max(judge MAD of S over the seed's runs judged twice, 1.96 * pooled SD of S over replicates * sqrt(2 / (T * k)))
